title: Northloop Protect Plans — Schedule of Plan Prices
content:
The price of each of the Northloop Protect Plans is set by the unit price of the covered item. Every plan has its own price ladder: the covered item's unit price places it in one price band, and the plan price is the figure shown for that band under the plan bought. On all six plans the plan price is paid as a single upfront payment.

## Plan price by covered item price band (USD)

| Covered item price band (USD) | Protect 1-Year Extended Warranty | Protect 2-Year Extended Warranty | Protect 3-Year Extended Warranty | Protect 2-Year Accident Protection | Protect 3-Year Accident Protection | Protect 4-Year Accident Protection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 10.00 to 49.99 | 3.99 | 5.99 | 7.99 | 8.99 | 11.99 | 14.99 |
| 50.00 to 99.99 | 6.99 | 10.99 | 13.99 | 14.99 | 19.99 | 24.99 |
| 100.00 to 199.99 | 11.99 | 17.99 | 23.99 | 29.99 | 39.99 | 49.99 |
| 200.00 to 499.99 | 24.99 | 37.99 | 49.99 | 59.99 | 79.99 | 99.99 |
| 500.00 to 999.99 | 49.99 | 74.99 | 99.99 | 119.99 | 159.99 | 199.99 |
| 1000.00 to 5000.00 | 89.99 | 134.99 | 179.99 | no such band | no such band | no such band |
| 1000.00 to 2500.00 | no such band | no such band | no such band | 199.99 | 259.99 | 329.99 |

The top band of the three Extended Warranty plans runs from 1000.00 to 5000.00 USD; the top band of the three Accident Protection plans runs from 1000.00 to 2500.00 USD. A plan has no price for a covered item price outside its own ladder.

## How the plan price is paid

| Plan | Payment of the plan price |
|---|---|
| Protect 1-Year Extended Warranty | Single upfront payment |
| Protect 2-Year Extended Warranty | Single upfront payment |
| Protect 3-Year Extended Warranty | Single upfront payment |
| Protect 2-Year Accident Protection | Single upfront payment |
| Protect 3-Year Accident Protection | Single upfront payment |
| Protect 4-Year Accident Protection | Single upfront payment |

## Reading the schedule (hypothetical illustrations)

- A covered item with a hypothetical unit price of 149.00 USD sits in the 100.00 to 199.99 band. Its plan price is 11.99 USD on Protect 1-Year Extended Warranty and 39.99 USD on Protect 3-Year Accident Protection.
- The band edges are read exactly as printed: a hypothetical unit price of 99.99 USD sits in the 50.00 to 99.99 band, and a hypothetical unit price of 100.00 USD sits in the 100.00 to 199.99 band.
- A covered item with a hypothetical unit price of 1800.00 USD sits in the top band of either family: 134.99 USD on Protect 2-Year Extended Warranty, 259.99 USD on Protect 3-Year Accident Protection.
